Fig. 6 Hemolytic activity in human red blood cells. Data are the average of at least four independent experiments. Error bars represent the standard deviations. Lowercase and uppercase letters indicate a significant difference in hemolysis rate of F2 or F3 (Tukey’s test, p < 0.05), respectively. The asterisk (*) denotes a significant difference between F2 and F3 (Student’s t-test, p < 0.05) at the same peptide concentration.
